entities.summary: American industrial research laboratory (est. 1925) that produced some of the 20th century's most consequential inventions: the transistor, laser, Unix operating system, C programming language, and information theory. Bell Labs researchers have received 9 Nobel Prizes, making it the most productive corporate research institution in history.
